entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts (DGI online code, 2017 consolidation incl. loi 2016-10)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (traders, tableau A exceptional class, Bamako: fixed duty by turnover + 10 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI art. 144 and 144-A tableau A (L.F. 2014, L.F. 2015, L.F.R. 2017; DGI online consolidation of 2017, later finance laws not held)
entries.doc: art. 144-A tableau A, exceptional class, trader with turnover excluding tax of at least 1 bn: 1 000 000 F (1st zone, district of Bamako); 600 M to 1 bn: 800 000 F; 300 to 600 M: 600 000 F; art. 144: proportional duty 10 % of the rental value, never below a quarter of the fixed duty.
unsupported: traders below 300 M of turnover (lower classes of tableau A) and the other professions and zones of the tariff

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: ML: the general tax code held (CGI.txt, 1018k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: ML: the general tax code held (CGI.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Taxe sur les véhicules automobiles (vignette, cars by fiscal horsepower)
entries.statute: CGI art. 166, 170 1) (L.F. 2013; DGI consolidation of 2017, later finance laws not held)
unsupported: two- and three-wheelers by cylinder capacity (art. 170 2)
half rate for vehicles bought after 1 October (art. 171)
exemptions (art. 167)

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus de valeurs mobilières, dividends (10 %)
entries.statute: CGI art. 41-42 1) (L.F. 2012, L.F. 2013; consolidation of August 2017 incl. L.F.R. 2017 — later finance laws not held, flagged)
entries.doc: art. 42: 1) dividends 10 % (7 % from companies listed on a CREPMF-approved exchange); 2) bonds 6 % (3 %/0 % for State bonds of 5-10 / over 10 years); 3) negotiable bonds of companies 13 %; 4) interest on sight or term deposits and current accounts 9 %; 5) bond lots 15 %; 6) other income 18 %.
unsupported: 7 % on dividends of listed companies (art. 42 1)
exemptions of art. 31

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus de valeurs mobilières, interest on deposits and current accounts (9 %)
entries.statute: CGI art. 42 4) (consolidation 2017; later finance laws not held, flagged)
unsupported: bonds 6 % / 3 % / 0 % and company bonds 13 % (art. 42 2-3)
other income 18 % (art. 42 6)

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus fonciers (12 % of gross rent)
entries.statute: CGI art. 17-19, 22 (L.F. 2012; consolidation 2017; later finance laws not held, flagged)
entries.doc: art. 17-19: base = gross rent received in the year, with no abatement of any kind; art. 22: 12 % for buildings in hard and semi-hard materials, 8 % for banco buildings; base rounded down to the thousand.
unsupported: 8 % for banco (earth) buildings
rounding of the base down to the thousand francs

entries.name: Taxe sur les plus-values de cession réalisées par les particuliers, shares (7 %)
entries.statute: CGI art. 121-124, 129 (loi n° 11-078, L.F. 2013, L.F.R. 2017; consolidation 2017, flagged)
entries.doc: art. 124: net gain = net sale price less the acquisition price; art. 129: 7 % on shares and partnership interests, 5 % on bonds, 15 % short-term and 5 % long-term on other gains.
unsupported: immovable gains: within two years taxed as short-term at 15 %, after two years 5 % with a 5 %-a-year abatement from the second year up to 50 % (art. 126-127, 129): the reading of 'from the second year' is not settled
bonds 5 %
exemptions (art. 123)

entries.name: Contribution forfaitaire à la charge des employeurs (3,5 %)
entries.statute: CGI art. 159-160 (consolidation 2017; later finance laws not held, flagged)
entries.doc: art. 160: 3,5 % of gross remuneration including benefits in kind, payable by all individuals and companies paying wages.
unsupported: exemption of young graduates hired under 40 (art. 161) and other recruits (art. 162)

entries.name: Taxe de formation professionnelle (2 %)
entries.doc: art. 184: 2 % of gross remuneration paid by persons liable to IS, BIC or agricultural profits tax.
unsupported: employers not liable to IS/BIC/BA are outside (art. 183)

entries.name: Taxe-emploi jeunes (2 %)
entries.doc: art. 185-B: 2 % of gross remuneration paid by persons liable to IS, BIC or BA and subject to the contribution forfaitaire.

entries.name: Taxe foncière (3 % of annual rental value; owner-occupied home exempt)
entries.statute: CGI art. 185-E to 185-L (loi n° 2011-035; consolidation 2017, flagged)
entries.doc: art. 185-H: base = annual rental value; art. 185-L: rate 3 %; art. 185-G 10°: buildings not let and occupied by the owner or dependent family members are exempt — the household's home is exempt, other buildings are taxed on their annual value.
unsupported: bare land used commercially or held over three years (art. 185-F)
other exemptions of art. 185-G

entries.name: Droit d'enregistrement sur les mutations d'immeubles à titre onéreux (15 %)
entries.doc: art. 269: base = price plus charges or an expert estimate; art. 270 (the only tariff of 'Mutations à titre onéreux — Les immeubles — B. Tarifs'): 15 %, reduced to 7 % for housing without a land title and for business acquisitions entered in the balance sheet.
unsupported: the consolidation prints art. 270 as applying to 'biens immeubles domaniaux'; it is read as the general rate (only tariff of the sub-section)
7 % for housing without a land title (titre foncier) and for business premises (art. 270-271)
halving for land bought to build housing (art. 276)

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions, donations)
entries.why: art. 301 tariff by fraction of the net share depends on the number of children (direct line 3-25 %) and has an overall 'Maximum' rate per class (e.g. siblings 20/27/33/40 %, maximum 35 %); art. 304 abatement of 2,5 M + 1,5 M per child shared among heirs: the household input carries neither the number of children nor the shared abatement
entries.tried: CGI.txt lines 7148-7440 (Section 2 Mutations à titre gratuit)

entries.name: INPS / AMO employer contributions (family 8 %, AMO 3,5 %, work accidents 1 %, old age 3,4 %, invalidity-death 2 %)
entries.statute: INPS Mali, 'Le guide du cotisant' (Code de prévoyance sociale art. 187; held copy ml/law/w5/ml_inps_guide_cotisant.pdf) [text version: INPS guide PDF of 10 August 2013 (file date); no later guide reached (flag)]
entries.doc: Guide: 'Les prestations familiales 8 % ; L'assurance maladie obligatoire : part de l'employeur 3,50 %, part du salarié 3,06 % ; Les accidents du travail ... 1 % à 4 % ; Assurance vieillesse : part de l'employeur 3,4 %, part du salarié 3,6 % ; L'invalidité et le décès 2 %'; base: 'l'ensemble des rémunérations du salarié' (art. 187).
unsupported: work-accident rate by activity (1-4 %): the lowest applied
guide undated (flag)
invalidity-death 2 % read as employer-only (the guide splits only AMO and old age)
